text: I've got two little ones and if it weren't for them, I'd have likely stopped going to McDonald's altogether. I get let down pretty much every time I visit....I actually cannot recall a recent visit at this or other McD's where they didn't get the Happy Meal order wrong (asked for apple slices but got fries, asked for book but got yet another cheap toy). For sure these guys are really just banking on their brand because the food quality ain't there. Guaranteed that their burgers get smaller and smaller...there's no way in hell that the quarter pounder is a quarter pound (and I mean even before cooking the patty. Pass and go to Spicebros if you're already in the West Island.
author: Mark Groot

text: I don't get the right order, which I waited for, and instead of simply giving me what I actually asked for, they ask me to return the food I got, so they can throw it in the trash, and then make me wait another 15 mins because of their incompetence. In other words, anything to prevent me from getting any kind of compensation for their lack of care in their work. I didn't want to wait anymore, so I ate what I got the first time. Wonderful experience... Make sure you like what you receive.
